newsitem.title: USA: New Holland NV files for $1.23 bln IPO.
newsitem.headline: New Holland NV files for $1.23 bln IPO.

text.p: New Holland N.V. said in a registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Tuesday that it plans to sell up to 53,475,000 common shares or $1,229,925,000 in its initial public offering.
The company said of the total amount, 46,500,000 shares are being offering in the United States. The underwriters have been granted an over-allotment option of up to 6,975,000 additional shares.

The offering is estimated to be priced between $20 and $23 per share, the filing said. The offering will be made through Goldman Sachs & Co, Morgan Stanley & Co Inc, Merrill Lynch & Co and Salomon Brothers Inc.

New Holland was formed in May 1991 through the merger of the business of Fiat Geotech S.p.A. and Ford New Holland Inc companies. New Holland is in the engineering, manufacturing, marketing and distribution of agricultural equipment.
The company plans to pay annual cash dividends following the offering, commencing with a dividend intended to be paid in 1997 for the 1996 fiscal year.
